covers: audience framing: a business reader gets impact and the decision first
prompt: My engineering manager has to decide next week whether this command-line tool gets more engineering time. Explain the tool to them in under 300 words. Reply in the chat as text.

assertions.describe: at most 330 words (the brief asked for under 300)
no code blocks for a manager
the first paragraph names impact, cost, risk or the decision

assertions.pattern: (we should|you should|I recommend|I'd recommend|recommendation|my advice|I suggest|the decision is|this means we)
assertions.describe: says what to decide (this means we should...)
at most two inline code spans
